card.name: Volume numbers in journal citations
card.fires_on: The space, punctuation or first digit right after a journal name in a reference, just before the volume number. It appears in citation lists with year, volume and page numbers.

modes.label: Gap after journal name
modes.description: A space, comma, semicolon or period after the journal title, right before the volume number.

modes.label: First digit of volume
modes.description: The first digit of a volume number after an abbreviated journal name.

card.plain: It lights up in reference lists at the spot where a journal's volume number is about to appear.
